en: Sepia postcard showing a courtyard with a large bronze armillary-sphere instrument set on a raised platform, in front of a traditional Chinese building with tiled roof and lattice windows; bare tree branches at right. French caption at the bottom reads "2. - PÉKIN. - Observatoire." The back is a divided French postcard layout labeled CARTE POSTALE with sections for CORRESPONDANCE and ADRESSE.
